### Why 25W charging can affect battery health

- **More heat:** 25W wireless charging generates more heat than 15W wireless charging.
- **Long-term battery aging:** Repeated exposure to high temperatures can accelerate lithium-ion battery degradation.
- **Charging protection:** iOS can slow or pause charging when the battery gets too warm. Charging speed also typically decreases above 80%.
